related.title: QuEra 中性原子：熱速度與 Doppler 退相位
related.titleEn: QuEra neutral atoms: thermal velocity and Doppler dephasing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付單顆／陣列存活、簇集診斷及流失後恢復狀態表。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver single/array survival, clustering diagnostics and post-loss recovery states. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『QuEra 中性原子：熱速度與 Doppler 退相位』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付熱速度、無量綱相位展寬及Doppler／雷射噪聲診斷矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'QuEra neutral atoms: thermal velocity and Doppler dephasing', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver thermal velocity, dimensionless phase spread and Doppler/laser-noise discrimination.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：若每原子獨立指數壽命τ，N顆在t內全部存活P=exp(−Nt/τ)；共同背景事件會破壞獨立性。 使用教學N=100、τ=100 s、電路窗t=0.1 s；τ為假想有效壽命。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-100*0.1/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：先算單顆exp(−t/τ)再取100次方；兩路徑必須一致。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：一維熱速度σv=sqrt(kBT/m)，高斯Doppler對比C=exp[−(keffσvt)²/2]；keff為兩光子有效波向量，非任一單束波數。 使用教學m=1.443×10⁻²⁵ kg、T=10 μK、keff=10⁶ m⁻¹、t=10 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-((1e6*sqrt(1.380649e-23*10e-6/1.443e-25)*10e-6)**2)/2)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：確認keffσvt無量綱；比較−lnC正比T，並將keff=0列作忽略其他噪聲時的理想極限。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For independent exponential lifetime τ per atom, all N survive time t with P=exp(−Nt/τ); common background events violate independence. Use Teaching N=100, τ=100 s and circuit window t=0.1 s; τ is a hypothetical effective lifetime. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-100*0.1/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compute single-atom exp(−t/τ) then raise to100; both routes must agree.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: One-dimensional σv=sqrt(kBT/m) gives Gaussian Doppler contrast C=exp[−(keffσvt)²/2]; keff is the effective two-photon wavevector. Use Teaching m=1.443×10⁻²⁵ kg, T=10 μK, keff=10⁶ m⁻¹ and t=10 μs. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-((1e6*sqrt(1.380649e-23*10e-6/1.443e-25)*10e-6)**2)/2) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless keffσvt; verify−lnC scales with T and use keff=0 as an ideal limit excluding other noise.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Convert noise decibels to linear variance and calculate vacuum noise mixed in by loss.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。輸入變異數0.25（約−6.02dB），透射η=0.8。 V出=0.8×0.25+0.2。 代入 0.8*0.25+(1-0.8)，得到 0.4 vacuum-normalized variance。以真空變異數1正規化，V出=ηV入+(1−η)；適用純損耗通道，不含額外技術雜訊。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Input variance0.25 (about−6.02dB), transmissionη=0.8. Vout=0.8×0.25+0.2. Substituting 0.8*0.25+(1-0.8) gives 0.4 vacuum-normalized variance. Normalize vacuum variance to1: Vout=ηVin+(1−η), a pure-loss channel without added technical noise. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
